Fantasy World Sim — test build
==============================

Start it
--------
Windows:  double-click fantasy-world-sim.exe
          (If SmartScreen warns "unrecognized app": More info -> Run anyway.
          The build isn't code-signed.)
macOS:    right-click fantasy-world-sim -> Open -> Open
          (Needed the first time only, because the build isn't signed.
          If macOS still refuses, run in Terminal, inside this folder:
            xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine .
          then try again.)
Linux:    ./fantasy-world-sim

Keep the "packs" folder next to the program: it holds the game's content.

Controls
--------
  Right- or middle-drag, WASD   pan
  Mouse wheel                   zoom
  Left click                    use tool (inspect, or paint)
  I / B                         inspect tool / paint tool
  [ / ]                         brush size
  Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y undo / redo
  M                             cycle map views
  Space, 1-5                    pause, speed

The World panel on the right generates new worlds: try World size,
Continents, Wrap and Climate, then "Regenerate world".

Found a bug? Note the seed (shown in the World panel) and what you did.
